purpose: Teach: オペラ/ラップ/スカウト/モバイル/プログラミング/思い切り/新車/停車

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お祖母ちゃんと、本気で、絶対、オペラ、絶対、見に行ったよ
lines.en: So I actually went to see an opera with Granny. For real.
lines.style: Bright, quick energy. Opening punch on the reveal. Natural cadence of someone sharing something surprising and genuinely excited about it. Slight lift at the end like she's inviting his reaction.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。最近、本気で、絶対、ラップ、絶対、ハマってるぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah? Dude, I've been seriously into rap lately.
lines.style: Warm, conversational. Genuine interest mirrored back. Casual confidence in the admission. Natural beat between the two thoughts, like he's meeting her energy while adding his own.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、野球部、絶対、スカウト、絶対、来そうだよね、リク
lines.en: You're actually going to get scouted by a baseball team someday, I'm telling you.
lines.style: Confident assertion wrapped in friendly teasing. Quick pace, no apology in the praise. Light on 「likely」 like it's obvious. Affectionate and matter-of-fact at once.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、モバイル、絶対、ゲーム、絶対、得意だよな、桜
lines.en: You're pretty damn good at mobile games though, aren't you.
lines.style: Observational, gentle call-back. Quieter than her energy but not distant. Slight questioning lilt at the end—not doubt, but inviting agreement. The tone of noticing something real about someone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前の、本気で、絶対、プログラミング、絶対、課題、絶対、上手だったよね、リク
lines.en: Your programming assignment was actually really well done, by the way.
lines.style: Sincere compliment offered without fanfare. Steady pace, specific praise. No over-sweetening. The delivery of someone who means what she says and expects him to know it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 試験前、本気で、絶対、思い切り、絶対、勉強しようぜ、桜
lines.en: Come on, let's actually study hard before the exam.
lines.style: Gentle push forward. Earnest without being preachy. Light pressure, like she's inviting him to match her energy. Warmth underneath the practical suggestion.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、新車、絶対、買ったらしいよ、リク
lines.en: Oh, and my dad apparently just bought a new car.
lines.style: Casual topic shift. Conversational, almost throwaway delivery. Slight smile in the voice like she's sharing neighborhood news. Not forcing importance but sharing anyway.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: コンビニ前、本気で、絶対、停車、絶対、禁止、絶対、だから、絶対、気をつけような、桜
lines.en: So like, don't park in front of the convenience store anymore—it's no parking now. Be careful, okay?
lines.style: Concerned but understated. Gentle warning with real care underneath. Slower pace on the practical detail, softer on the closing check-in. The tone of someone who noticed something that could affect him.
